dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: "War Rages Through Natlan: Which of the Six Tribes Will Prevail?"

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: As long as I can just get this article written out, the headlines for next week, even the week after... They'll be in the bag!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: All that time, all that effort, coming all the way from Fontaine... It'll all be worth it! I only brought a single Kamera, but that should be enough...

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Let me think... I still need to go interview some other contestants... Oh yeah, they're even saying the Pyro Archon herself will be appearing, aren't they?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: If I can get a picture of her... Hehe, won't that be a massive scoop?
